A '''Mandalorian male''' was a member of [[Clan Jendri]] and a [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]]. In [[3954 BBY]], along with the remaining [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clans that had survived the [[Mandalorian Wars]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he joined his own clan in the [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for the ancient ceremonial war mask known as [[Mandalore's Mask]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]]. During the search, [[Clan Ordo]] invaded Jendri's territory one night, and in retaliation the pilot and his clan [[Skirmish on Rekkiad|attacked]] Clan Ordo's campsite. During the battle, his Basilisk was damaged by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], and he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].

==Biography==
[[File:Revan_Headshot.png|thumb|200px|The Jedi Master Revan killed the pilot during the skirmish.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual was part of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Clan Jendri]] and a [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].<ref name="Revan" /> In [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the remaining Mandalorian clans that had survived the [[Mandalorian Wars]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] journeyed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]] to [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for the ancient ceremonial war mask, [[Mandalore's Mask]]&mdash;whoever found the mask first however would become the new [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]], the leader of the Mandalorians. Early one morning, he and three pilots [[Skirmish on Rekkiad|razed]] the campsite of [[Clan Ordo]] in retaliation of Ordo's invasion of their territory, as each clan chose its own territory in which to search for [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore's]] Mask. He and the other Basilisk pilots concentrated their assault from above, while Jendri [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Ground warfare/Legends|attacked]] by ground near Ordo's Basilisks in an attempt to keep the enemy pilots from reaching their deadly [[Sentience/Legends|semi-sentient]] [[Droid/Legends|machines]]. The [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], who had accompanied [[Canderous Ordo]], a Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], to help Ordo's clan in the search, realized their strategy and attacked the Basilisk pilot and his allies in order to distract their attention from Clan Ordo's Basilisks.<ref name="Revan" />

The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master charged the pilot and [[Force jump/Legends|leaped]] high in the air using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to slice through one of the stabilizing fins, damaging the tail. The pilot tried to pull his Basilisk in a steep climb, but the damage dealt caused the machine to veer wildly out of control. After the malfunction, Revan leaped onto the back of the droid and the pilot tried to repel his unwelcome passenger, but the Jedi Master easily evaded his reach and [[Shiak|slid]] his lightsaber through the back seat, impaling the pilot through the torso and killing him.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Clan Jendri pilot first appeared in [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="Revan" />
